senses.gloss: 1. अष्ट mfn. (√ अक्ष्; cf. निर्-√ अक्ष्) ‘marked, branded’, only in comp. with -कर्ण
2. अष्ट fr. √ 1. अश्. See अ॑-समष्ट-क्˚.
3. अष्ट (in comp. for अष्टन्).
4. अष्ट अष्ट or अष्टा with the final अ,आ blended in comp.
अष्टा (in comp. for अष्टन्)
1. अष्ट—कर्ण mfn. branded on the ear, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 115
2. अष्ट—कर्ण m. ‘eight-eared’, N. of Brahman (who is supposed to have four heads), L.
अष्ट—कर्णी॑ (ई॑), f. a cow branded on the ear, RV. x, 62, 7.

अष्टन् अष्टौ॑ [RV.; AV. &c.] or अष्टा॑ [RV. viii, 2, 41] or अष्ट॑ [RV. x, 27, 15; AV. &c.] pl. eight (other forms are: gen. अष्टानाम्, Mn. &c.; instr. अष्टभि॑स्, RV. ii, 18, 4; ŚBr. &c.; loc. अष्टासु॑, ŚBr. &c.);
अष्टन् [Lat. octo; Gk. ὀκτώ. Goth. ahtau; Mod. Germ. acht; Eng. eight; Lith. asztůni; Slav. osmj.]

अष्ट—कर्म-परिभ्रष्ट m. a Jaina, L.

अष्ट—कोण m. an octagon, L.
अष्ट—खण्ड m. N. of a collection of different passages of the RV.
अष्ट—गव n. a flock of eight cows, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 46 Comm., (cf. अष्टा-गव)
अष्ट—गव mfn. drawn by eight oxen, MBh. viii, 799.
अष्टा—गव mfn. (a car) drawn by eight oxen, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 46 Comm.
अष्ट—गुण mfn. eightfold, Mn. viii, 400
अष्ट—गुण n. ‘eight qualities’, in comp., e.g. अष्टगुणाश्रय mfn. endowed with the eight qualities (as a king), L.
अष्टगुणाश्रय mfn., endowed with the eight qualities (as a king)
अष्ट—गृहीत mfn. = अष्टा-गृह्˚, q.v., KātyŚr.

consisting of forty-eight verses, N. of a Stoma.

अष्टा॑—चत्वारिंशत् (अष्टा॑-), f. forty-eight, ŚBr.
अष्ट—तय n. (in later language for अष्टा-तय, q.v.) a collection of eight different things.
अष्टा—तय n. pl. eight different things, AitBr.
अष्ट—त्रिंश mfn. the thirty-eighth, MBh.

अष्ट—त्व n. condition of eight, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 84, Sch.

(see दिक्-पति and -पाल.)
अष्ट—धा॑ ind. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 42 seq.) eight-fold, in eight parts or sections, AV. xiii, 3, 19; VS. &c.
अष्ट—धा॑—विहित॑ mfn. divided into eight parts, ŚBr. vi.

अष्ट—नवत mfn. the ninety-eighth.

अष्ट—पद् m. (nom. -पाद्), ‘having eight legs’, a spider, L.
the fabulous animal generally called Sarabha, L.

(in ritual language) a pregnant animal, VS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (also neg. अ॑न्-अष्टापदि, ‘not a pregnant animal’, ŚBr.)
a wild sort of jasmin, L.
अष्ट—पद mf(आ)n. having eight Padas (as a metre), RPrāt.
consisting of 8 words, Mālatīm., Sch.
अष्ट—पाद mfn. having eight legs, MBh. iii, 10665
अष्ट—पाद m. a kind of spider, L.
the fabulous animal Śarabha, L.
अष्टा—पद m. ‘having eight legs’, a spider, L.
a worm, L.
the fabulous animal Sarabha, L.
a wild sort of jasmin, L.
a pin or bolt, L.
the mountain Kailāsa, L.
a chess-board on which each line has 8 squares or 64 in all, MW.
अष्टा—पद m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि, q.v.) a kind of chequered cloth or board for drafts, dice, &c., Hariv.; R. &c.

v.l. -पादिका ed. Calc.
अष्ट—पादिका See -पदिका above.
अष्ट॑-पुत्र (अष्ट॑-), mf(आ)n. having eight sons, AV. viii, 9, 21; TĀr.
अष्ट॑-पुरुष (अष्ट॑-),mfn. consisting of eight persons, TĀr.
अष्ट—पुष्पिका f. a wreath made with eight different kinds of flowers, Kād.
अष्ट—भोग (a fiscal term), Inscr.
अष्ट—मङ्गल n. a collection of eight lucky things (for certain great occasions, such as a coronation &c.) e.g. a lion, a bull, an elephant, a water-jar, a fan, a flag, a trumpet, and a lamp
(or, according to others, a Brāhman, a cow, fire, gold, ghee, the sun, water, and a king)
अष्ट—मङ्गल m. a horse with a white face, tail, mane, breast, and hoofs, L.
अष्ट—मान n. a measure (one कुडव, q.v.), Śārṅg.

अष्ट—मूर्ति-धर m. ‘possessing eight forms’, a N. of Śiva.
अष्ट—मूली f. a collection of eight roots from different plants, VarBṛS.
अष्ट॑—योनि (अष्ट॑-), mf(ई)n. having eight places of origin, AV. viii, 9, 21; TĀr.
अष्ट—रत्न n. ‘the eight jewels’, N. of a collection of eight Ślokas on ethics.
अष्ट—रत्नि m. 8 Aratnis long, MBh.
अष्—˚टारत्नि mfn. 8 Aratnis long, ŚBr.
अष्ट—रसाश्रय mfn. endowed with the eight rasas (or sentiments of poetry).
अष्ट—र्च॑ m. (fr. ऋच्) a hymn consisting of eight verses, ŚBr. ix.
अष्ट—लोह n. = -धातु, q.v., Hcat.
अष्ट—वर्ग mfn. being in rows of eight each, KātyŚr.
अष्ट—वर्ग m. a class of eight principal medicaments (viz. Ṛṣabha, Jīvaka, Medā, Mahāmedhā, Ṛddhi, Vṛddhi, Kākoli, and Kṣīrakākolī), L.
अष्ट—वर्ष mf(आ)n. eight years old, Mn. ix, 94.

अष्ट—विकल्प mfn. of eight kinds, Sāṅkhyak.
अष्ट—विध mfn. eightfold, of eight kinds, Mn. vii, 154, &c.
अष्ट—वृष॑ mfn. having eight bulls (?), AV. v, 168.
अष्ट—शत n. a hundred and eight, VarBṛS.; Jain.
eight hundred, Yājñ. i, 302
अष्टा॑—शत (अष्टा॑-), n. a hundred and eight, ŚBr. x.
अष्ट—शती f. id., Sūryas.
अष्ट—शत—साहस्र mfn. consisting of eight hundred thousand, MBh. iv, 288.
अष्ट—शतक n. a hundred and eight, MBh. iii, 158.
अष्ट—श्रवण or अष्ट—श्रवस्, m. (= -कर्ण, q.v.), ‘eight-eared’, N. of Brahman, L.
अष्ट—श्रवण or अष्ट—श्रवस्, m. (= -कर्ण, q.v.), ‘eight-eared’, N. of Brahman, L.
अष्ट—षष्ट mfn. the sixty-eighth.

अष्टा॑—सप्तति (अष्टा॑-), f. seventy-eight, ŚBr. xiii.
अष्ट—सप्ततितम mfn. the seventy-eight.
अष्ट—साहस्रक mf(इका)n. consisting of eight thousand (i.e. ślokas, as one of the Buddhist Prajñāpāramitās).
अष्ट—स्तना॑ [MaitrS.] or अष्ट॑-स्तना [ŚBr.] f. (a cow) whose udder has eight teats (cf. अष्टा॑स्तना.)
अष्टा॑—स्तना (अष्टा॑-), f. = अष्ट-स्तना॑, q.v. TS.
अष्टा॑—चक्र (अष्टा॑-), mf(आ)n. having eight wheels, AV.
अष्टा—चत्वारिंशक mfn. lasting forty-eight years, PārGṛ.
= -चत्वारिंशिन्, q.v., Pāṇ. v, 1, 94 Comm.

अष्टा—र्च॑अष्टा—र्चअष्टा—दश—र्च n. (ऋच्), a hymn consisting of eighteen verses or lines, AV. xix, 23, 15.
अष्टा-दश—र्च॑ (for -ऋच॑), a stanza or hymn of 18 verses, AV.
अष्टा-दश—वक्र m. N. of a mountain, Divyāv.
अष्टा-दश—वक्रिका f. N. of a mythical river, ib.
अष्टा—दशम mfn. the eighteenth.

अष्टाङ्ग—नय m. prostration of the eight parts of the body (in performing very profound obeisance; the eight parts are the hands, breast, forehead, eyes, throat, and middle of the back; or the first four, with the knees and feet; or these six, with the speech and mind), L.

अष्टाङ्ग—पात m. prostration of the eight parts of the body (in performing very profound obeisance; the eight parts are the hands, breast, forehead, eyes, throat, and middle of the back; or the first four, with the knees and feet; or these six, with the speech and mind), L. [see साष्टाङ्ग-पातम्]

अष्टाङ्ग—प्रणाम m. prostration of the eight parts of the body (in performing very profound obeisance; the eight parts are the hands, breast, forehead, eyes, throat, and middle of the back; or the first four, with the knees and feet; or these six, with the speech and mind), L.
अष्टाङ्ग—प्रणिपात m. prostration of the 8 parts of the body (= -प्रणाम), PārGṛ.

अष्टाङ्ग—समन्वागत mfn. (said of a feast), Divyāv.
अष्टाङ्ग—हृदय n. N. of a medical work of Vāgbhaṭa
अष्टाङ्˚गार्घ्य n. an offering of eight articles (water, milk, Kuśa grass, curds, ghee, rice, barley, and mustard; or honey, red oleander flowers, and sandal are substituted for the last three).
अष्टाङ्—˚गोपेत mfn. (said of excellent water), ib.
अष्टाध्यायी f. ‘a collection of eight books or chapters’, N. of ŚBr. xi
also of Pāṇini's grammar.
अष्टार mfn. having eight spokes, NṛsUp.
अष्टार—चक्र-वत् mfn. ‘having a wheel with eight spokes’, a N. of Mañjuśrī, Buddh.
अष्टाशीति f. eighty-eight
अष्टाशीति—शत n. pl. आनि a hundred and eighty-eight, BhP.
अष्टा॑श्रि mfn. having eight corners, ŚBr.
अष्टास्रि mfn. id., MBh. iii, 10665.
अष्टाह mfn. lasting eight days (as a certain Soma sacrifice), KātyŚr.

अ॑ष्टक n. a whole consisting of eight parts (as each of the eight Aṣṭakas of the RV., or as, TS. i, or as Pāṇini's grammar &c.)

अष्टका f. the eighth day after full moon (especially that in the months Hemanta and Śiśira, on which the progenitors or manes are worshipped, ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. &c.; अष्टका is therefore also a N. of the worship itself or the oblations offered on those days, Kauś. &c.), AV. xv, 16, 2; ŚBr. &c.
a N. of the Acchodā river, MatsyaP.
आष्टक n. N. of a district, Pat. on Kāty. Vārt. 31 on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104.
अष्टकाङ्ग n. a kind of dice-board having eight divisions, L.
अष्टका-श्राद्ध n. a Śrāddha performed at the Aṣṭakā festival, ĀpGṛ.
अष्टकिन् mfn. one who performs an Aṣṭakā, (g. व्रीह्य्-आदि, q.v.)
अष्टक्य mfn. relating to an Aṣṭakā, (g. गव्-आदि, q.v.)
अष्टक्या f. a cow employed at the A˚ f˚, Kauś.

अष्टम-देश m. intermediate region (= अन्तरा-दिश्), Gobh.
अष्टमक mfn. the eighth, Yājñ. ii, 244
अष्टमिका f. a śukti or weight of four tolas.
आष्टमिक mfn. taught in the eighth (book of Pāṇini), Pat.
1. अष्टि f. N. of a metre consisting of sixty-four syllables (like that in RV. ii, 22, 1; RPrāt.)
the number, ‘sixteen’, Sūryas.
2. अष्टि f. (√ 1. अश्), reaching, AV. vi, 54, 1 (cf. जर॑द्-अष्टि, व्य॑ष्टि, स॑मष्टि.)
3. अष्टि f. (= अस्थि, q.v.) the kernel or stone of a fruit, BhP.
अष्टिन् mfn. consisting of eight members or syllables, RPrāt.
अष्टिक mfn. having the length of eight, Śulbas.
अ॑ष्ट्रा f. a prick or goad for driving cattle (regarded as the badge of the agriculturist, Kauś.), RV.;
अष्ट्रा [Zd. astrā; Lith. akstinas.]
आष्ट्र n. (fr. √ 1. अश्, Uṇ. iv, 159), ether, sky, atmosphere
आष्ट्रा f. a prick or goad for driving cattle (= अष्ट्रा, q.v.), Kāṭh.
अष्ट्रा—वि॑न् mfn. obeying the goad (as a bull), RV. x, 102, 8.
आष्टकीय mfn. belonging to or coming from the above country, ib.
आष्ट्री॑ f. an extensive forest [Sāy.], RV. x, 165, 3.
आष्ट्रा-दंष्ट्र॑ n. N. of a Sāman, MaitrS.
